newsitem.title: GERMANY: MOTOR RACING-CLEAN SWEEP FOR MCLAREN-BMW.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-CLEAN SWEEP FOR MCLAREN-BMW.

text.p: Briton Steve Soper and Fin JJ Lehto headed a clean sweep for the new McLaren-BMW combination in the opening round of the World GT championship on Sunday.
The three McLaren-BMW teams beat the strongest field of grand touring cars seen in more than 20 years.
The French pair of Jean-Marc Gounon and Pierre-Henri Raphanel finished second with John Nielsen of Denmark and and German Thomas Bscher third.

The sole factory Porsche crashed on the first corner when driven by German Hans Stuck and he and co-driver Thierry Boutsen of Belgium spent the rest of the four-hour race catching up, doing well to finish in fourth place.
